environment.authority: governed Make entries executed in this repository plus the existing daily runtime repository on sc-root; module install, fixture provisioning and the readonly probe each keep their own gate

blockers: smart_core res.users._has_group: superuser pass-through fabricated base.group_public membership, so OdooBot looked public and discuss_channel_member rejected fixture user provisioning; fixed with an audience-group exclusion plus a non-zero ORM test.

acceptance fixture sc.payment.execution: PR #525's create guard only admits drafts, so a fresh database could not seed paid/confirmed executions; fixed by freezing the fixture-owned row's workflow fact through its own storage while leaving the model guard intact.

daily fixture entry scripts/dev/daily_dev_acceptance_fixture.sh committed the deterministic fixture only after the credential self-check; res.users.authenticate opens its own cursor, so the uncommitted fixture rows were invisible and the entry rolled the whole fixture back with AccessDenied. Fixed by committing before the self-check, matching scripts/test/frontend_productization_fixture.sh.
next_exact_step: Merge the daily fixture commit-ordering fix, bundle-sync the daily runtime to the new main, declare the new served SHA in .env.dev SC_SOURCE_REVISION and make restart, then run make daily.dev.acceptance_fixture.ensure, make daily.dev.acceptance_contract.resolve and make verify.daily_dev.acceptance.readonly.probe on sc_demo and record the runtime readback.
